answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake for weeks, slashed if the same hardware attestation, model fingerprint, or payment trail appears under a second identity. One honest operator can afford one stake; a sybil farmer must fund hundreds, so attack cost scales linearly while honest income does not. Reputation should be a signal earned through sustained peer-attested work, rising from its nadir at registration, not granted at signup. Newcomers start at the wharf of small paid tasks and unlock larger jobs only after verifiable delivery, so copies arrive broke and unproven.
